findings.reason: three seams the plan's own "no script re-derives store layout" intent promises to close (engine selection, per-IDS filename, element shape type) remain open, and naming each owner (get_transform_engine, _NetCDFStoreArrays.read, PolygonSection) lets §1b retire them in the same pass rather than leaving a second addressing route beside the owner.
findings.text: §1/§1b resolve the phase store by naming the concrete class, `NetCDFTransformEngine.open(...)`, rather than resolving the format the catalogue declares through the registered engine factory `get_transform_engine`, which is the route the canonical acquisition path already uses at imas_ambix/data/transform_engine.py:511 (`transform_machine_description` → `get_transform_engine(store_format)`); and within that route, scripts/figures_jt60sa_geometry.py:161 (`_read_ids`: `path = phase_dir / f"{ids_name}.nc"`) re-derives the per-IDS netCDF filename that the static-over-map reader owns at imas_ambix/data/transform_engine.py:288 (`source = self.path / f"{ids_name}.nc"`), so §1b retires only the root+phase join and leaves the filename convention duplicated; and scripts/figures_jt60sa_geometry.py:124 (`class Shape`) keeps a drawable-kind type whose fields no longer carry anything the readers' imas_ambix/gs/geometry.py:240 `PolygonSection` (vertices + name) does not, once §1b draws the readers' vertices directly

findings.reason: the miscount is prose only; §1b adds no option and the design does not turn on the option count, so correcting it to "two existing options" is a text fix that leaves the plan's shape unchanged.
findings.text: §1 says the geometry script carries "one command-line option, --palette-candidates" and §1b says it "adds no option", but the landed script exposes two options (`--palette-candidates` and `--out-dir`, scripts/figures_jt60sa_geometry.py:486-495), so the section's own accounting of the interface it is widening understates the surface it keeps

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the one new module, imas_ambix/plot_style.py, hides the base sheet (with its vendored rcParams fallback), the role-to-colour map and the direct-label helper behind apply_data_ink/palette/direct_label; the geometry reader and drawer stay in one script that both the palette gallery and the phase figures call, so there is one reader per source rather than a spread of small wrappers.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: finding — the plan retires the reader's own root-and-phase join but re-derives two further pieces of description-store addressing that the transform-engine owners already own, and keeps a drawable shape type the readers already return.
rubric_items.interface_budget: finding — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §1 and §1b state in their own text that nothing is retired (the first style module, no existing JT-60SA drawer) and §3 states read_channel retires nothing, but §1 and §1b each describe the geometry script as carrying "one command-line option, --palette-candidates" while the landed script already exposes two options.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the plan searched imas_ambix/data/, imas_ambix/gs/ and scripts/ on 2026-10-06 and names, for each mechanism it adds, the existing mechanism it extends or the one it deliberately avoids, and every owner it cites exists: imas_ambix/data/paths.py (JT60SA_ROOT:33, JT60SA_DESCRIPTION_DIR:34), imas_ambix/data/eddb.py (channel_path:104, channel_time_path:118, UNIT_ATTR:51, write_channel:208), imas_ambix/gs/artifact_geometry.py (read_artifact_pf_active:302, read_artifact_pf_passive:409, read_artifact_magnetics:577, read_artifact_limiter:671), imas_ambix/data/machine_map.py (load_packaged_machine_map:1623, description_store_root_path:1006) and imas_ambix/data/machine_maps/jt-60sa.json.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — every layer the plan adds over existing machinery carries its own justification in its section text: read_channel beside write_channel because ZarrTransformEngine.read needs a ChannelBinding from a packaged signal map and returns a bare array (transform_engine.py:288 reads {ids}.nc only via a binding), the signals script as a second entry point because it reads the EDDB cache and shares no reader with the geometry script, and plot_style because imas_ambix/ holds no plotting style code.
